top_signals.title: Iraq Seeks Federal Control Over Disputed Kurdistan Oilfields
top_signals.summary: The Iraqi government wants oilfields in the semi-autonomous Kurdistan region owned by the federally-held North Oil Company to be placed under federal control after uncovering oil smuggling in the northern fields, Iraq’s Oil Minister, Basim Mohammed Khudair, has said. “An investigation has been conducted, the findings of which will yield specific recommendations. top_signals.title: Commission imposes provisional import quotas on hybrid passenger vehicles
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 24 Nov 2026 The European Commission today published provisional safeguard measures setting import quotas for certain hybrid vehicles. These restrictions are needed to protect EU industry against a sharp recent increase in imports of such vehicles. The measures will enter into force on 1 December and follow an investigation that showed imports of hybrid vehicles into the EU have increased significantly since 2023.

top_signals.title: How does EIA compare different types of energy?
top_signals.summary: To compare production and consumption across different resources, we convert to a common energy metric, British thermal units (Btu), which typically measures the heat content of the fuels such as petroleum, natural gas, and coal that are burned for energy. For energy sources such as hydropower, wind, solar, and geothermal that aren't combusted to create energy, we apply a constant conversion factor based on the heat content of electricity.
